title: Lucky Thompson in the band
summary: Greene says Lucky sounded very good in the band and recalls that few stayed long.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So -- I was away then. How did Lucky Thompson sound with the band then?
Good. Very good.
Did he?
Yeah. He sounded good. Very good.
But, later he preferred to play alto, didn't he?
No, he played soprano.
Soprano.
Soprano. Yeah.
But, he didn't play soprano when he was in the --
No. But, not in the band. He only played tenor in the band.
Yeah.
No. But, he sounded good.
Oh, he did?
Yeah. I really enjoyed his playing.
Did you?
Yeah.
Oh. Well, that's good. That's interesting Stan, because, you know -- with all the different tenor stars that the band's had --
Yeah.
-- you know -- not many people ever talk about Lucky in the band.
Yeah. Yeah. They don't.
Well, he wasn't there too long, you know, -- because then they get Illinois Jacquet.
Yeah. You know, Lucky wasn't there long. You see, most of these guys, they didn't stay --
It wasn't a family anymore. Was it? To much moving?
No. they moved around so much, and so fast.
